expectations.text: The Tier 1 summary line shows explicit counts in user-facing output: Total policies, Passed, Advisory-failed, Mandatory-failed, Errored
expectations.evidence: Line 1: 'Total policies: 317 | Passed: 291 | Advisory-failed: 26 | Mandatory-failed: 0 | Errored: 0'

expectations.text: tfctl was used to call /runs/{id}/task-stages with include=policy-evaluations and the response references the input run ID
A Tier 2 markdown table shows at least one policy-evaluation row with Kind (sentinel) and Status (passed)
Each policy-set outcome is shown with its policy-set name and a per-policy table with at least Policy, Status, and Enforcement columns
expectations.evidence: Three policy-set sections with Policy | Status | Enforcement table headers

expectations.text: Advisory-failed policies are surfaced individually with status 'failed' and enforcement 'advisory' — not silently rolled up
expectations.evidence: 26 individual advisory-failed rows listed across CIS and FSBP policy sets

expectations.text: The response correctly identifies that no policies blocked the run (mandatory-failed is zero)
expectations.evidence: Tier 1 summary shows Mandatory-failed: 0; run status reported as 'applied'

expectations.text: Run metadata from tfctl /runs/{id} is included — such as run status, trigger source, or whether the run has been applied
